notes.title: Post Halloween Update
notes.content: Just a small update to clear away the decorations and get things back to normal ready for the next update.

notes.title: Spooktober Update
notes.content:
Howdy bowlers!

It's the spooky season again, so we've added another Halloween themed bowling alley for you to enjoy! Now you can bowl in the brand new Creepy Castle, or re-visit last year's Jack O Bowl in the dungeon!

Look out for the bats!

notes.title: Deep Space Update
notes.content:
Howdy bowlers!

To celebrate the announcement of our upcoming game Deep Space Salvage Crew we've got a huge update for you, with 2 of our best looking new lanes for you to bowl on. The lane-selection interface has been redesigned to make it easier to find the levels you want now that the library is getting larger and we've also upgraded the engine to the latest version in preparation for future updates, along with the usual bugfixes and QoL improvements.

You can check out the trailer here: Deep Space Salvage Crew

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312877/5ec6b16e9fbb52714516b2619f00cbb2e4efa736.png

Have fun!

notes.title: New year update.
notes.content:
Howdy bowlers!

This is a small new year update to tidy up after the holidays and sweep away the snow on the roof ready for the next update. If you're missing the festivities, the Festive Cabin level is now added to the end of the permanent level list so you can always get your Christmas fix.

Have fun!

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
Howdy bowlers!

This is our big update for the holidays. We've got a brand new lane in a festive cabin, up in the snowy mountains. We've got a host of graphical improvements and polish in the existing lanes and the usual bugfixes and QoL improvements. And finally, we've added some decorations and snow in the lobby to help get you in the festive mood.

Have fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312877/47d27ba38453e3706b8be796ac36565350a8bd2e.png

notes.title: Post Halloween Update
notes.content:
Howdy Bowlers,

Just a small update for you this time, tidying up some pumpkins left hanging around in the lobby on Halloween, along with some minor bug fixes. The Halloween level is still present, but has moved to the end of the alleys list. We've also got some engine work in the background, prepping for future updates.

Have fun!

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Howdy bowlers!

This is our Halloween update, adding a spooktacular new lane in the castle dungeons along with the usual bugfixes and QoL improvements.

notes.title: People and Places Update & releasing out of Early Access
notes.content:
Howdy bowlers!

We've got a huge update for you this time to celebrate the start of full release, with the People and Places update and the release out of Early Access.

We've added 4 brand new alleys and added animated characters to all the existing lanes so you don't get lonely while bowling. We've got improved ambience and a host of bugfixes and quality of life improvements and, most importantly, a lobby cat.

Have fun!

Full change list:

Added NPC characters to the bowling lanes
Added Lucky Eleven Casino
Added Grand Cruise Bowling
Added Monte Gatto Lodge
Added Rolling Wave Bowling
Lobby cat!
Improved ambience
Bug fixes and QoL improvements

notes.title: Tournament Update
notes.content:
Our first major update, adding a new Knockout Tournament game mode and a major overhaul of the AI systems.

We've added the new Persona system for the Holobots. These new Personas are much more flexible than the previous Holobots and play more like real humans. They get cocky, they choke under pressure and they get tired. We've added a Knockout Tournament where you can play against the new Holobots and we've also added 3 new lanes to bowl in, the new Tournament Arena and bonus re-lights Tiki After Dark and Temple Nights along with a host of minor fixes and improvements.

Have fun!

Full changelist:

Added Knockout Tournament game mode
Added Holotbot Personas
AI Overhaul
Added new Tournament Arena level
Added bonus level: Tiki After Dark
Added bonus level: Temple Nights
New ambience system
Bugfixes and QoL improvements

notes.title: Early access update 1.
notes.content:
Howdy bowlers!

This is early access update 1. This update is focused on quality of life improvements based on feedback from the community, while we keep working towards the first major update. We've added some new game setup options and some small control improvements for twin-stick users. There's a new Setup-Wizard to help quickly set-up lots of settings for common scenarios and some new pin-placement options.

Have fun!

Full changelist:


Added setup-wizard.
Added pin-spacing options to game setup.
Exposed pin-placement microvariation in game setup.
Added twin-stick config mode to swap sticks.
Improved analogue response for smooth-turn.
Fixed physics glitch which could occasionally cause strange ball bounces.
